batch_label: Scrapped status for the 18 rows IGU 2026 dropped + Puteri Delima Satu -> FSU (2026-09-17)
reason: IGU World LNG Report 2026 dropped 18 backend `active` rows (IGU reconciliation batch 2026-09-17_1458ET). All 18 were sold for demolition. Baird 2026-09-17: add Status `scrapped`; never delete a row - every scrapped vessel moves to `scrapped`, whichever side of Dec 2025 the scrapping falls. Each Status cell carries press refs stating the completed demolition sale plus the shipvault record; refs replace the IGU-2025 landing page that supported `active`. Live row 61 Puteri Delima Satu: Vessel type conventional -> FSU on two MISC primary documents.
